summary: Genius Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the voluntary dissolution of wholly-owned subsidiary Revealed Films, Inc., completed May 13, 2026. This is an exit/disposal equivalent to a divestiture. The dissolution reduced liabilities by $5.46M and generated a $5.46M net gain. The board authorized ICC arbitration against RF's founders to recover ~$2.57M under purchase price adjustment provisions. No deal terms are disclosed. What to watch: outcome of arbitration and impact on balance sheet.
